channel.title: The Barons of AI
channel.description: Founder stories from the intelligence age. The Barons of AI tells the life stories of the people building the AI era — the founders, engineers, and iconoclasts turning research into industries. Each episode goes deep on one builder: where they came from, the decisions that mattered, and the lessons worth stealing. For anyone who wants to understand how the future gets built.

item.title: Liang Wenfeng and DeepSeek
item.description: The quant trader who stockpiled ten thousand AI chips before anyone knew why, gave the models away for free, and accidentally started a price war that humiliated every tech giant in China. The story of DeepSeek's Liang Wenfeng - patience as strategy.

item.title: Greg Jackson and Octopus Energy
item.description: A Founders-style deep dive into Greg Jackson, who started Octopus Energy in 2016 and built it into Britain's largest energy supplier, with the Kraken software platform spun out at an .65B valuation. Seven lessons from his life and decisions.
